about: Split calls from the first look of wave 15.

Three places round the bay: 43 to 66 in the north-west, 37 to 42 by the west shore, 01 to 36 on the east point.
Two places 900 m apart: 01 to 29 in the north and 40 to 49 at the south end.
Two places: 01 to 41 on the west side (north lot and shore road) and 42 to 50 across the cove 900 m east.
Three places either side of the highway bridge: F01 to F03 on the west point, D01 to D13 on the middle shore, C01 to C31 on the east shore.
Two places 600 m apart across the marina: loop A in the north and sites 01 to 51 on the south point.
The loop with 01 to 27 and GS3 in the south-west, and group sites GS1 and GS2 at the end of the road 1 km north-east.
Two places 1 km apart on the point: the south loop (01 to 30) and the north loop (31 to 64).
